scene_description: A compact area with three small hut-like structures made of different materials. One oak planks hut contains the trapped chest, one stone brick hut contains a regular chest (distractor), and one spruce planks hut contains a barrel and crafting table (distractors). The player must explore and locate the trapped chest specifically.
task_text: Find the trapped chest hidden in one of the buildings in the area.
design_notes: Three buildings arranged around spawn: oak planks hut (SE, contains trapped chest at ~7 ~1 ~11), stone brick hut (NW, contains regular chest distractor at ~-6 ~1 ~-6), spruce planks hut (N, contains barrel and crafting table distractors). All buildings have doorway entrances. The trapped chest is inside the oak building which requires the player to enter and look at the back wall. Player spawns at origin facing south by default.
